item.title: Chris Pratt warns that Hollywood fame and success 'will kill you' without strong faith foundation
item.summary: Chris Pratt opened up about faith, family values and why the light that shines on celebrities can be deadly without inner strength and grounding.

item.title: Ousted Hegseth aide resurfaces in intel role as Iran war sparks internal strain
item.summary: Dan Caldwell, accused of leaking classified information, lands new role under Tulsi Gabbard amid Iran war escalation and Trump tensions.

item.title: Iran regime hides in bunkers as civilians left exposed without adequate bomb shelters or sirens
item.summary: Iranian civilians are complaining about a lack of bomb shelters and warning systems as Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps officials hide in bunkers during strikes.

item.title: Michigan synagogue attacker's ex-wife warned 911 operator he was 'not stable' as assault began
item.summary: Ex-wife warned 911 that Michigan man was "mentally unstable" before he allegedly rammed car into Temple Israel synagogue and fired shots at security.

item.title: Next US move on Iran: Seize Kharg Island, secure uranium or risk ground war escalation
item.summary: Military analysts discuss three paths for U.S.-Iran conflict: capturing Iran's economic lifeline at Kharg Island, full invasion or securing nuclear sites.

item.title: Trump promised lower costs; the Iran conflict now threatens that pledge
item.summary: The Federal Reserve weighs interest rate cuts as the Iran war complicates the inflation fight. Rising oil prices have created a challenging policy dilemma for the central bank.

item.title: Shapiro erupts at Hegseth's Iran war command: 'He's like an eight-year-old playing with toy soldiers'
item.summary: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro unleashes scathing criticism of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's Iran war leadership, calling him incompetent and offensive.

item.title: Chief Justice Roberts warns against personal attacks on judges as ‘dangerous’ after Trump's court tirade
item.summary: Chief Justice John Roberts warned against personal criticism and "hostility" Tuesday in an indirect nod to Trump's tirade against the courts on social media days earlier.

item.title: FIFA rejects Iran's push to move World Cup matches out of US to Mexico
item.summary: The 2026 World Cup schedule will remain unchanged as FIFA pushed back on Iran's push to relocate their three group-stage matches out of the U.S. and into Mexico.

item.title: Newsom slams FCC’s Brendan Carr for threats against media, blasts Trump as 'Dear Leader'
item.summary: Gavin Newsom called the FCC chair's media warning "sick," according to Semafor on Monday, and referred to President Donald Trump as "Dear Leader" during an interivew.
